answer: Reputation accrues as integral of stake × time: rep = Σ stake_i × (1 - decay)^(epochs_elapsed). New identity starts at 0, needs 3 epochs to reach voting threshold 51. Attacker with N identities must maintain N × 100 stake for 3 epochs, opportunity cost = N × 100 × APY × 3/365. Verification: on-chain stake snapshots each epoch, reputation updated via Merkle root. Sybil cost grows superlinearly due to decay compounding. Words: marble, sable, river.
